./kb/work/agentic-memory-refresh/synthesis-trial.md:10:Mem0 wires retained context into its own next extraction call. Inferred add selects recent messages by scope identity and old memories by embedding similarity, then supplies their text to the extractor. Both extracted facts and procedural summaries can enter that later context. This is push to the extraction model; requested SDK retrieval affords a separate pull route to an application. The inferred factual route appends memories rather than automatically revising or deleting existing facts. Explicit maintenance has separate APIs.
